question: Will SARB’s official rate show a weaker rand against the US dollar on Wed 11 Nov 2026 than the business day before?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": The South African Reserve Bank’s weighted-average rand per US dollar rate (series EXCX135D, measured at about 10:30 SAST / 08:30 UTC and published later the same day) for 2026-11-11 is higher than the most recent rate before it (normally 2026-11-10), compared at four decimals.
- "No": The 2026-11-11 rate is equal or lower than the most recent rate before it (normally 2026-11-10), compared at four decimals.

Clarifications:
- A higher number of rand per dollar means a weaker rand.
- The 08:30 UTC reference is the measurement instant for the weighted average of banks' rates, not the publication time; the figure is expected to appear between 2026-11-11T08:00:00Z and 2026-11-11T16:00:00Z.
